description: The 7 customizable slots every character has. Each slot holds one item; items are unlocked by level and bought with coins.

slots.name: Hair / Helmet
slots.what: Hairpiece, hat, helmet or crown (sits on the head)

slots.name: Torso
slots.what: Printed torso with arms and hands (clothes, armor)

slots.name: Shoes
slots.what: Colour/material of the feet (boots, steel, gold). Painted onto the foot area of the legs

slots.name: Gear
slots.what: Right-hand weapon, left-hand shield/tool, neck piece (shoulder armor or cape)

slots.name: Ride / Companion
slots.what: Vehicle or creature next to the character (skateboard up to dragon / spaceship)
